question: The National Literacy Mission (NLM) was set up in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1988.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** National Literacy Mission **(NLM) was set up in **1988.**
 
• It was launched by the Government of India with the aim to** eradicate illiteracy **and provide** functional literacy **to non-literates.
 
• The mission has been successful in **reducing the overall illiteracy rate** in the country from** 52.21% in 1991 to 26.67% in 2011.**
 
• The NLM has also been instrumental in **promoting adult education, women's education**, and** education for marginalized sections **of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Literacy Mission is one of the** largest adult education programs** in the world.
 
• The NLM aims to** impart functional literacy to non-literates** in the age group of **15-35 years.**
 
• The mission has been successful in establishing **1.3 million adult education** centers across the country.
 
• The NLM has also been successful in promoting the use of technology in** education,** with the introduction of programs like the **Computer Literacy Program (CLP) and the Interactive Radio Instruction (IRI) program.**
